name: Experiment 9 HQ8 Local-vs-Global Head Contribution

fixed_evaluation.source: Experiment 2 Stage B document-disjoint artifact reused by Experiment 8

head_order.ablation_site: attention output immediately before dense W_O

matched_random_family.construction: exhaust all C(8,4)=70 masks; remove the global head in four groups and the local head in the complementary four groups

local_contribution_gate.rule: run 9B only if discovery delta-local is positive and confirmation delta-local is at least 0.001 with paired-bootstrap CI lower bound above zero

alignment_evidence_rule.rule: alignment evidence requires positive discovery mean, confirmation mean at least 0.001, hierarchical-bootstrap CI lower bound above zero, and at least 75% of derangements positive

interpretation_limits: single trained seed and one checkpoint
paired sequence confidence intervals do not quantify training-seed uncertainty
head zeroing is an off-distribution intervention and does not equal retraining without those heads
the 32 derangements are a frozen diagnostic sample, not all 14833 derangements of eight chunks
